rule.title: Code Y, a qualified charitable distribution: the gross stays on 4a, 4b is 0

citation.wording: If all or part of the distribution is a qualified charitable distribution (QCD), enter the total distribution on line 4a. If the total amount distributed is a QCD, enter -0- on line 4b.

rule.open_point: Code Y says a QCD was claimed, not how much of the distribution it was. The whole of box 2a is excluded; a part that was not a QCD, and anything above the $108,000-per-person limit, is taxable and is the preparer's to enter.
